## Why this model

One independent model per stock, each with its own `s(year)` smooth plus
SST/salinity/NAO effects, `family = student()`. This is different from the
per-stock random-walk / AR1 attempts in `04b-glmm-sdmtmb.qmd`, which failed
because a RW/AR1 gives roughly one free parameter per year, matching the
number of yearly observations almost exactly, which saturates. A penalized
regression spline `s(year, k = ...)` with a modest `k` (well below each
stock's number of years) has strictly fewer effective parameters than years
by construction, and its wiggliness is further constrained by REML-style
penalty selection, so it doesn't hit the same saturation failure.

Figures below match the style already built for `m2b` in `04-glmm-brms.qmd`
(fixed-effect distribution, per-stock slope caterpillar plot, year-effect
panels, trajectories colored by SST slope), but built from 79 independent
per-stock fits rather than one shared mixed model, and none of them facet by
stock (all stocks overlaid in a single panel instead).

## Read and wrangle data

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(sdmTMB)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(slider)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(ggsidekick)
theme_set(theme_sleek())

home <- here::here()

dat <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/dat.csv"))

nao <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/env/NAO data - extended time series.csv")) |>
  dplyr::rename(year = Year)

nao <- nao |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(nao = slide_dbl(winter_NAO, mean, .before = 4, .complete = TRUE))

mid_year <- round(median(1959:2022))

# ML: Same data prep as 04-glmm-brms.qmd / 04b-glmm-hgam.qmd, kept identical
# so results are comparable across all modeling approaches tried.
d <- dat |>
  mutate(
    species_f = as.factor(Species),
    stock_f = as.factor(stock),
    year_ct = year - mid_year
  ) |>
  group_by(stock_f, species_f) |>
  arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    sst_lag1      = lag(sst, 1),
    salinity_lag1 = lag(salinity, 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(year >= 1959) |>
  left_join(nao, by = "year") |>
  mutate(
    sst_sc_lag1       = (sst_lag1 - mean(sst_lag1, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(sst_lag1, na.rm = TRUE),
    salinity_sc_lag1  = (salinity_lag1 - mean(salinity_lag1, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(salinity_lag1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = stock_f
  ) |>
  mutate(nao_sc = as.numeric(scale(nao))) |>
  mutate(
    b0_sc = (b0 - mean(b0, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(b0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = stock_f
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(b0_sc, sst_sc_lag1, salinity_sc_lag1, nao_sc) |>
  droplevels()

d |> summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .by = stock_f) |> pull(n_years) |> summary()
```

## Fit one model per stock

```{r}
# ML: k = 5, well below the shortest stock's series length (17 years), so
# REML has room to shrink further rather than hitting one-parameter-per-year
# saturation the way the RW/AR1 attempts did.
stock_list <- levels(d$stock_f)

fit_one_stock <- function(st, dd) {
  fit <- sdmTMB(
    b0_sc ~ s(year, k = 5) + sst_sc_lag1 + salinity_sc_lag1 + nao_sc,
    spatial = "off",
    spatiotemporal = "off",
    data = dd,
    family = student()
  )

  coefs <- tidy(fit, "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) |>
    mutate(stock_f = st)

  # ML: Marginal year effect -- predicted at reference covariate values (0).
  nd_marginal <- tibble(
    year = min(dd$year):max(dd$year),
    sst_sc_lag1 = 0,
    salinity_sc_lag1 = 0,
    nao_sc = 0
  )
  marginal <- predict(fit, newdata = nd_marginal, se_fit = TRUE) |>
    mutate(stock_f = st)

  # ML: Full on-data prediction -- each row's own actual observed
  # SST/salinity/NAO for that stock-year, not held at a reference value.
  full_pred <- predict(fit, newdata = dd, se_fit = TRUE) |>
    mutate(stock_f = st)

  list(fit = fit, coefs = coefs, marginal = marginal, full_pred = full_pred, ok = TRUE, error = NA)
}

results <- vector("list", length(stock_list))
names(results) <- stock_list

for (st in stock_list) {
  dd <- d |> filter(stock_f == st) |> droplevels()
  res <- tryCatch(
    fit_one_stock(st, dd),
    error = function(e) list(fit = NULL, coefs = NULL, marginal = NULL, full_pred = NULL, ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
  )
  results[[st]] <- res
  cat(st, "- ok:", res$ok, if (!res$ok) paste("- ERROR:", res$error) else "", "\n")
}

saveRDS(results, paste0(home, "/output/sdmtmb_per_stock_results.rds"))

ok_stocks <- names(results)[map_lgl(results, ~ isTRUE(.x$ok))]
cat("\nFit successfully:", length(ok_stocks), "of", length(stock_list), "stocks\n")
```

## Fixed effects across stocks (matches pars.pdf style)

```{r}
coefs_all <- map_dfr(results[ok_stocks], "coefs")

coefs_all |>
  filter(term %in% c("sst_sc_lag1", "salinity_sc_lag1", "nao_sc")) |>
  mutate(term = recode(term, sst_sc_lag1 = "SST", salinity_sc_lag1 = "Salinity", nao_sc = "NAO")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, fill = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~term, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = "Per-stock estimate", y = "Density")

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/sdmtmb_perstock_pars.pdf"), width = 14, height = 16, units = "cm")
```

## Caterpillar plot: per-stock SST and salinity slopes (matches stock_slopes.pdf style)

```{r}
stock_slopes <- coefs_all |>
  filter(term %in% c("sst_sc_lag1", "salinity_sc_lag1")) |>
  mutate(
    covariate = recode(term, sst_sc_lag1 = "SST", salinity_sc_lag1 = "Salinity"),
    covariate = factor(covariate, levels = c("SST", "Salinity")),
    sig = case_when(
      conf.low > 0 ~ "Positive sig.",
      conf.high < 0 ~ "Negative sig.",
      TRUE ~ "No effect"
    )
  )

ggplot(stock_slopes) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(y = stock_f, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = sig), height = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(y = stock_f, x = estimate, color = sig), size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Positive sig." = "steelblue",
    "Negative sig." = "tomato",
    "No effect"     = "grey70"
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~covariate, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Estimate (independent per-stock model)", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5)
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/sdmtmb_perstock_slopes.pdf"), width = 20, height = 22, units = "cm")
```

## Year effect: all stocks overlaid, not faceted (matches year_preds.pdf / stock_trends_by_temp.pdf style)

```{r}
marginal_all <- map_dfr(results[ok_stocks], "marginal") |>
  left_join(stock_slopes |> filter(covariate == "SST") |> select(stock_f, sst_total_slope = estimate), by = "stock_f")

ggplot(marginal_all, aes(year, est, color = sst_total_slope, group = stock_f)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "magma", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = expression(paste("Marginal predicted ", B[0], " (scaled), reference covariates")),
    color = "SST slope"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(position = "inside", title.position = "top")) +
  theme(
    legend.position.inside = c(0.15, 0.12),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.65, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/sdmtmb_perstock_year_marginal.pdf"), width = 19, height = 14, units = "cm")
```

## On-data prediction: all stocks overlaid, not faceted

```{r}
full_pred_all <- map_dfr(results[ok_stocks], "full_pred") |>
  left_join(stock_slopes |> filter(covariate == "SST") |> select(stock_f, sst_total_slope = estimate), by = "stock_f")

ggplot(full_pred_all, aes(year, est, color = sst_total_slope, group = stock_f)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "magma", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = expression(paste("Predicted ", B[0], " (scaled), actual covariate values")),
    color = "SST slope"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(position = "inside", title.position = "top")) +
  theme(
    legend.position.inside = c(0.15, 0.12),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.65, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/sdmtmb_perstock_full_pred.pdf"), width = 19, height = 14, units = "cm")
```
